When muscles are stabilised using compression, they work more efficiently:​

  • Keep muscles in place to reduce fatigue​
  • Improved awareness of body position ​
  • Increases oxygenated blood flow to working muscles​ in the body

settings.ggVnyDrRcEB_text: Compression isn’t just tight sportswear, it’s precision equipment designed to help your body perform better. Backed by medical science and engineered with targeted muscle support, our compression is built to prepare your muscles for movement, improve performance in action, and accelerate recovery after every session.​

settings.ggenFJMS-nt_text:
After training or competition, compression helps
your body reset:​

  • Reduces swelling in covered areas​
  • Decreases Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness
  • Supports lymphatic drainage of toxins​

Extra firm compression garments boost circulation
post-exercise, helping muscles recover faster so
you’re ready to go again sooner.​

settings.ggOdOZi9kCv_text: Yes. When properly designed and fitted, compression tights help support circulation, reduce muscle soreness and assist recovery—helping you move and recover more efficiently.
settings.ggRMSlwGKcv_text:
Compression tights help support performance and recovery by:

  • Supporting circulation
  • Reducing muscle fatigue
  • Keeping muscles warm
  • Aiding post-workout recovery

They’re suitable for training, running, sport, leisure and travel.
settings.ggSdYaQmuy7_text: Compression tights are performance garments designed to support the body during training, recovery and everyday movement. Available in a range of fits, silhouettes and colours, they’re built to help you feel and look your best—whatever the activity. They can be worn during workouts, as a base layer, or post-exercise to support recovery.
settings.ggZhSQDnycq_text: No. Compression tights are designed for all activity levels, with different compression levels available for training, leisure, recovery and travel.

settings.ggkA_LWiPiC_text:
Compression isn’t one-size-fits-all.​ The right piece depends on:​

  • When you’re wearing it​
  • How you’re moving​
  • What your body needs next​
settings.ggxO-JRPaKV_text: Leggings are designed mainly for comfort and style. Compression tights are engineered to actively support muscles, circulation and recovery through targeted compression.

Decades of research show that true sports compression can:​ reduce injury risk​, improve performance​, and speed up recovery​. 

 

With premium, durable yarns and advanced graduated profiles, our compression goes beyond standard sportswear— it’s engineered to actively support your body in motion.​
